query: How do I collect my Singapore citizenship certificate?
reference_answer: You will be required to attend the citizenship ceremony to collect your original Singapore citizenship certificate. More details of the citizenship ceremony would be sent to you via email once the details are finalised.
context:
[Document 1]
You will be required to attend the citizenship ceremony to collect your original Singapore citizenship certificate. More details of the citizenship ceremony would be sent to you via email once the details are finalised.

[Document 2]
As a new citizen, you are required to attend the citizenship ceremony at the respective Group Representation Constituencies (GRCs) to collect your Singapore citizenship certificate. The ceremony would usually take place in approximately three to six months after your date of registration. Once the date of ceremony is firmed up, you or your sponsor will receive an email informing the detailed information concerning the ceremony.

answer: To collect your Singapore citizenship certificate, attend the citizenship ceremony at your GRC. Details will be sent to you via email about 3-6 months after registration. [Document 1-2]
